items.evidence: apiLevel 2.13, labware loaded with the required labels, and the p300 handles every volume (40–200 µL). Mix volumes (80 and 45 µL) fit within the well contents, and all end_state checks pass.
Every add_to_plate, remove_to_waste and transfer_pairs call does pick_up_tip and drop_tip for each well. The tip_before_aspirate, tip_dropped_at_end and no_cross_contamination checks all passed.

All 13 steps run in order with the right volumes, 10x mixes after the beads and the water, and protocol.comment records for the incubation, magnet, drying and disengage steps. Nothing extra is added and the comments match the actions.
add_to_plate(40, bead_source, sample_wells, mix_reps=10, mix_volume=80) adds beads and mixes 10x. A 5 min incubation comment follows before the magnet comment.
A comment records engaging the magnet and waiting 5 min. remove_to_waste(90) clears every well, then two rounds of add_to_plate(200) ethanol and remove_to_waste(200) follow.
Comments record a 5 min air dry and disengaging the magnet. 50 µL water is added with a 10x mix, then comes the 2 min incubation and magnet re-engage comment.
transfer_pairs(45, sample_wells, elution_wells) pairs the wells in order, A1 to A1 and so on, using a fresh tip each time.

judge.summary: The protocol follows all 13 steps in order with correct volumes, a fresh tip per well, and comment records for the manual steps. All measured checks passed and I found no deviations.
